'''Walnut Beach''' is a town beach and surrounding neighborhood located in [[Milford, Connecticut]] and was formerly the site of an amusement park. A boardwalk along the shoreline connects to the beach at [[Silver Sands State Park]] to the east and [[Charles Island, Connecticut|Charles Island]].

==History==
In 1923, an amusement park was built at Walnut Beach by the Whitham brothers. A dance hall and a boxing arena drew thousands in the summer.<ref name="Mirror-carousel">{{cite news |last=Dion |first=Jill |url=https://www.milfordmirror.com/news/article/Carousel-may-be-coming-back-to-Walnut-Beach-13876995.php |title=Carousel may be coming back to Walnut Beach |work=Milford Mirror |date=2013-03-29 |accessdate=2023-01-02 }}</ref> In 1938, a [[1938 New England hurricane|hurricane]] destroyed many of the rides. The park continued into the 1940s and was refurbished in the 1950s by Frank and Les Smith.<ref name="Mirror-toast">{{cite news |last=Flores |first=Saul |url=https://www.milfordmirror.com/news/article/It-s-a-toast-to-Milford-A-part-of-city-16258338.php |title=It's a toast to Milford,' A part of city history returns to Walnut Beach |work=Milford Mirror |date=2021-06-20 |accessdate=2023-01-01 }}</ref> Subsequent redevelopment brought an end to the park.<ref name="Mirror-carousel"/>

== Climate ==
In the summer months, Walnut Beach can reach highs into the upper 90°F. Walnut Beach has a record high temperature of 103°F in the month of July. The coldest day on record was -7°F in the month of January.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://weather.com/weather/monthly/l/Milford+CT+USCT0121:1:US|title=Milford, CT Monthly Weather Forecast - weather.com|work=The Weather Channel|access-date=2017-04-25|language=en-US}}</ref>
